 Indian fans gather in Wellington before third T20I vs New Zealand 
 By
 TNM (With ANI Inputs) 
 ✓
 27 October 2026, 11:32 am 
 2 min read
 27 Oct 2026 
 ANI Photo | Indian fans gather in Wellington before third T20I vs New Zealand 
 Indian supporters assembled outside Hnry Stadium in Wellington on Tuesday ahead of the third Twenty20 International (T20I) between India and New Zealand. India, leading the five-match series 2-0, are aiming to secure the series victory in Wellington.
 Despite missing key players Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya, India have demonstrated strong form by winning the first two matches against New Zealand, who were runners-up in the 2026 T20 World Cup.

 Sunny, an Indian resident from Gujarat who has lived in Wellington for three years, expressed his excitement about attending his first match at the stadium. He said, “I am from Gujarat, India and I’ve been living here for about three years. It’s a T20 match today! The excitement is immense, the match starts around 8.00 or 8.30 am, but we’ve arrived two hours early. It should be a good match. This is our first time watching a match here in Wellington, our first time in the stadium. We’re really excited; we’ve been waiting for about three years for the Indian team to come here.”
 Another fan from Kerala stated, “We are so excited. I’m supporting India. I’m a big fan of the Indian team, and I’m a big fan of Sanju (Samson). I really want his autograph…”
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 India’s recent T20 performances have highlighted the format’s unpredictability. After becoming the first team to defend the T20 World Cup title successfully, India faced challenges with a series loss in Ireland, a defeat in England, and a 2-2 draw against the West Indies at home.
 However, the Indian team has shown a strong response in New Zealand, winning both matches despite limited preparation time and conditions favouring pace bowlers. India has also won nine of their last ten T20Is against New Zealand, a record that adds to their confidence ahead of the Wellington match.
